==> Caveats
==> portable-ruby
portable-ruby is keg-only, which means it was not symlinked into /usr/local,
because portable formulae are keg-only.

If you need to have portable-ruby first in your PATH, run:
  printf '%s\n' export\ PATH\=/usr/local/opt/portable-ruby/bin:\$PATH >> ~/.zshrc

For compilers to find portable-ruby you may need to set:
  export LDFLAGS=-L/usr/local/opt/portable-ruby/lib
  export CPPFLAGS=-I/usr/local/opt/portable-ruby/include

For pkgconf to find portable-ruby you may need to set:
  export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/opt/portable-ruby/lib/pkgconfig
